title: Inference Efficiency Onboarding: visuals & screenshot library for Optimize Toolkit
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: Produce a compact, re-usable visual asset pack and annotated screenshot library that explains Optimize Toolkit recommendations (batching, prefix/KV caching, and quantization profiles) for first-time users and in-console help. Deliverables should support: 1) in-console contextual tips; 2) marketing quickstart tiles; 3) a single-page onboarding doc; and 4) a screen-by-screen annotated image pack for engineering to embed in release notes. Focus on clarity for engineers and platform owners (not novice ML users).
acceptance_criteria: A single Figma file with named frames for each deliverable: hero card, compact settings rail, full-screen recommendation modal, annotated screenshot pack
PNG and SVG exports for each frame at the specified sizes (see screenshots_spec)
Accessibility checklist completed for all text overlays (contrast ratios, readable font sizes)
Design sign-off from PM (Arjun Patel) and Platform UX lead (Priya Rao)
Assets uploaded to Drive with README that lists intended placements and alt text for each image
updates: 2026-02-10 - Maya Chen: Created ticket and sketched initial information architecture for the onboarding flow. Prioritized three entry points: console tip, quickstart modal, and release notes screenshots.
2026-02-12 - Liam O'Connor: Uploaded first-pass wireframes to Figma. Decision: keep recommendation messaging segmented by user persona (Platform Engineer vs Product Engineer).
2026-02-14 - Liam O'Connor: Iterated visual language — introduced the 'efficiency delta' mini-chart (tokens/sec & cost-per-token) for recommendation cards. Shared with PM for feedback.
2026-02-16 - Arjun Patel (PM): Reviewed visuals; requested clearer CTA label for 'Apply profile' and asked to add copy variant that emphasizes SLA-safe defaults. Added to acceptance criteria.
2026-02-18 - Maya Chen: Accessibility pass started; contrast adjustments made. Preparing export specs and documenting localization needs.
screenshots_spec: hero_card: 1200x628 PNG (for marketing and release notes), SVG for scalable exports
recommendation_modal: 1440x900 PNG and layered PDF for engineers
annotated_pack: 800x600 PNG each screen, with numbered callouts and alt-text in README
accessibility_notes: All text overlays must meet WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1) — updated color tokens available in Figma styles
Use system UI font fallbacks for small labels to maintain legibility at 12px
Include alt text for each exported image in the Drive README
localization_notes: Designs must allow for German and Japanese translations (expect +20% width), avoid tight truncation
Use separate text layers in Figma and export localized variants into subfolders in Drive
implementation_notes: Engineering will consume annotated PNGs and a compact JSON manifest (fields: filename, target_location, alt_text, suggested_copy). Will coordinate with ENG-2112 for placement hooks
Avoid embedding real customer data in screenshots — use anonymized mock tokens and sample throughput numbers
